issue_request: FHIR-30379 is a Published/Persuasive R5 FHIR-I request to clarify Subscription $status id parameter behavior, especially resource-level versus instance-level handling, multiple-id representation for GET/POST, and the fact that absent ids return all caller-visible Subscriptions only for Subscription/$status, not Subscription/[id]/$status. The approved resolution was to update R5 to match the R4 Backport issue FHIR-30378.
initial_application: The source history shows prior application: 17740f61cd imported R4B/backport-style $status wording, and f1da78150b explicitly applied FHIR-30379 to source/subscription/operationdefinition-Subscription-status.xml by refining the id parameter, status parameter, and return Bundle documentation. No prior combined-branch Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-30379 existed before this audit.
additional_context: Subscription and SubscriptionStatus are active build-scoped resources, and source/subscription/list-Subscription-operations.xml includes OperationDefinition/Subscription-status. The R4 Backport counterpart FHIR-30378 is Published/Persuasive and its current published operation page carries the same semantics. R5 and current CI core pages render the clarified text. Later applied issues FHIR-47291 and FHIR-47292 changed the same operation's description/return guidance but did not alter the id parameter behavior.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current OperationDefinition already states that id is ignored at the instance level, applies at the resource/type level, returns all available Subscriptions only when no resource-level ids are supplied, and joins multiple values as OR; this preserves the applied clarification without adding redundant representation-specific prose.
